title: Wish the Fish
summary: A young fish discovers it has the ability to guide others through dangerous waters, becoming the hero of its pond.

pages.text: A fish lived in a small pond.
pages.scene: A small golden fish swimming happily in calm water

pages.text: This fish was shy and wished to help.
pages.scene: Fish watching other creatures from behind weeds

pages.text: When it rained, the water was bad and thick.
pages.scene: Heavy rain making the pond murky and dangerous

pages.text: The shell was lost! Which way? Help!
pages.scene: A frightened turtle shell floating, unable to see

pages.text: The fish did chat and think.
pages.scene: Fish thinking hard about how to help
Fish swimming determinedly toward turtle, showing path

pages.text: The fish sang and rang a rock.
pages.scene: Fish making sounds to guide turtle through storm

pages.text: The shell was safe at last!
pages.scene: Turtle reaching safety in shallow, calm waters

pages.text: The shy fish was the thing they needed! The end.
pages.scene: Fish and turtle together, pond creatures celebrating the hero
